answer: Plant decoys in the grading queue. Each epoch the network hides a few canary answers among real ones, some empty, some that beg for a perfect score, and no grader can tell which seats carry them. A sybil farm that approves everything to mirror the majority and collect agreement pay will pass a canary sooner or later, and one approval ejects the key and flags every sibling funded from it. Like water through karst, lazy verdicts leak out of the system, and a reputation can only reach its zenith through many careful reviews.
